== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Grandmaster [[Lirial]] is a high-ranking official and a [[Territory]] whose abilities focus on the collection and preservation of intelligence rather than direct combat. Historically, [[Lirial Travelers]] served as watchful sentinels and scouts for the [[Elysian Traveler|Elysian Travelers]]. As a Grandmaster, [[Lirial]] is involved in strategic military planning, such as identifying vulnerable [[Trees]] for potential assault during wartime. [[Lirial]] possesses the ability to utilize gates that shift locations based on the movement of the moons and can use crystal lenses to observe distant events. The entity's physical appearance is characterized by silver ribbons, silver wire, and white crystal, often wearing a [[The mask|mask]] or possessing a crystal head. While the gender of the Grandmaster is not explicitly known to others, the [[Lirial Incarnation]] is described as a woman of silver and crystal who can use light-based attacks and specialized star-nets to incapacitate targets. [[Lirial]]'s role involves maintaining surveillance on key figures like [[Alin]], the [[Elysian Traveler]], and monitoring various conflicts across different territories.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|This figure is wrapped in silver. Their voice is characterized by a toneless buzzing sound.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|As the mysterious leader of the [[Lirial Travelers]], this Grandmaster holds specific beliefs regarding others, such as viewing [[Leah]] as a frightened natural [[Traveler]] from the villages.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Lirial]] utilizes a crystal lens to conduct observations of [[Alin]] and his sisters.}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Grandmaster [[Lirial]] serves as the mysterious leader of the [[Lirial Travelers]]. Appearing as a silver-wrapped figure, the Grandmaster communicates with a voice that resembles a toneless buzz. During recent events, [[Lirial]] acted as a potential source of interference on the [[Lirial]] side and utilized a crystal lens to observe [[Alin]] and his sisters.}}
